name: dependency-manager
description: Manages project dependencies (install, remove, list, outdated, audit). Auto-detects package manager (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun). Deterministic — no LLM needed.

inputs.name: Project Directory
inputs.description: Path to the project root directory

inputs.name: Action
inputs.description: Action to perform: install, remove, list, outdated, audit

inputs.name: Dev Dependency
inputs.description: Set to 'true' to install as dev dependency

outputs.name: Package Manager
outputs.description: Detected package manager (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun)

outputs.name: Command Output
outputs.description: Raw output from the package manager command
